attribution.rationale: Confirm inherited TOML declaration and append-only evidence contracts after the RNG-fork resume change.

decisions.rationale: The RNG-fork option is an explicit resume operation recorded in derived-run provenance; it does not add a scientific hyperparameter to the TOML declaration or bypass canonical configuration resolution.

The existing append-only evidence contract already covers complete lifecycle events with run, step, configuration digest, and algorithm; recording whether checkpoint RNG state was restored is an additional provenance field within that contract.
